title: feat: support options serialize and deserialize
author: shulandmimi
summary: Makes `ParserOptions` (incl. css_modules `Config`, `Pattern`, `Segment`, `ParserFlags`) serde-serializable and includes `options` in `StyleSheet`'s serde output, so a deserialized stylesheet keeps its CSS modules config. Adds the `bitflags/serde` feature.
evidence: No maintainer response (author pinged 2025-07-11). This changes the serialized shape of `StyleSheet` (new `options` field, with no `#[serde(default)]`, so previously serialized stylesheets would fail to deserialize) and adds new public serde surface. Based on a 2025 master; css_modules::Config has likely gained fields since, so it needs rebasing.
decision: Should `StyleSheet`'s serde form include its `ParserOptions` (new public serde API and serialized-shape change), or should callers keep passing options separately after deserializing?
